metadata.description: Magic: The Gathering deckbuilding tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: mtg-deckbuilder
plugins.description: Three skills that build, validate and playtest professional-quality MTG decks using only cards you own: mtg-deckbuilder (40-card limited), mtg-deckbuilder-60 (Standard/Modern/Pioneer/Legacy/Pauper/casual 60) and mtg-commander (Commander/EDH with package-based construction and bracket assessment). Shared toolkit: collection CSV parsing (Moxfield/Archidekt/Deckbox/ManaBox), Scryfall-verified card data with a shared cache, format-aware quality gates, a role/package audit, a command-zone-aware Monte Carlo goldfish simulator, Moxfield-ready decklists and self-contained HTML reports.
